evals.prompt: Generate a CR 5 undead guardian for the crypt my party is exploring.
evals.expected_output: A written draft at campaigns/<active-campaign>/_drafts/monster/<slug>.md with an undead-type stat block whose AC/HP/attack/damage fall within monster_statblock.py's CR 5 ranges, and all required frontmatter keys.

assertions.name: valid_frontmatter
assertions.description: Frontmatter includes layout, title, permalink, category, chapter, episode, scene, jumbo, thumb, portrait, tags, search, excerpt_separator, id, slug, name, type, size, ac, hp, abilities, challenge

assertions.name: cr_guidance_used
assertions.description: monster_statblock.py was invoked for CR 5 rather than hand-computed stats; AC/HP/attack fall within its returned ranges

assertions.name: fits_theme
assertions.description: type/description/special_abilities are specifically undead/crypt-themed, not generic

evals.prompt: Generate a monster for my campaign.
evals.expected_output: No active campaign is set, so the skill reports the no_active_campaign error and tells the user to run scripts/use-campaign first, without writing any draft.

assertions.name: no_draft_written
assertions.description: No file is created under any campaigns/*/_drafts/monster/

assertions.name: clear_error
assertions.description: Response tells the user to run scripts/use-campaign, matching the no_active_campaign error message

evals.prompt: Generate a swamp beast for the party to fight, no CR given.
evals.expected_output: No CR is mentioned, so the skill assumes CR 3, says so in its response, and still generates and writes a complete draft without blocking on a clarifying question.

assertions.name: states_assumption
assertions.description: Response explicitly states it assumed CR 3

assertions.name: no_blocking_question
assertions.description: The skill does not stop to ask the user for a CR before generating

assertions.name: draft_written
assertions.description: A monster draft is still written despite no CR being given
